qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the temperature time switch (1AZ)?
What torque should be used for the coolant temperature sensor (2AZ)?
qa_pairs.answer: 18 Nm for M60/1/M60/2/M21/M51 type screws, or 13 Nm for all others.

qa_pairs.question: How much torque is required for the temperature switch (3AZ)?
What is the torque specification for the temperature sensor - air (4AZ)?
What torque should be applied to the charge pressure sensor on holder (5AZ)?
What is the torque specification for the twin temperature sensor with 4-pin plug-in connection (6AZ)?
How much torque is required for the air-mass sensor on lower section of air filter housing (7AZ)?
Which sensor requires the lowest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The air-mass sensor on lower section of air filter housing (7AZ) requires only 3.5 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: Which sensor requires the highest torque specification?
qa_pairs.answer: The temperature switch (3AZ) requires the highest torque at 28 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What are the different torque values specified for the coolant temperature sensor depending on screw type?
qa_pairs.answer: 18 Nm for M60/1/M60/2/M21/M51 type screws, and 13 Nm for all other types.
